data.title: bn-75b: Make runtime and shipping commands accept projects

data.body: Correction with literal identifiers: HIGH: The shared resolver now parses every standalone cart at project.rs lines 144-146, but oneshot::run maps every resolver failure to exit 2 at oneshot.rs lines 125-130. Before this change a readable malformed .cart reached Session::load_cart and exited 1; the documented contract still says cart-load failures exit 1 at command-reference.md lines 49-50. The built binary confirms that console run /dev/stdin --frames 0 with a cart missing the __lua__ section now exits 2. Project compiler/source errors take the same exit-2 path even though they are execution inputs, not invalid CLI syntax, while pack and serve classify the same failures as exit 1. Preserve the existing standalone-cart behavior and consistently classify project compilation failures, likely by returning a typed resolver error or deferring standalone cart parsing to Session, and add regressions for a malformed .cart plus an invalid project source.
